tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I found Evergreen Catering's invoices, but before paying I need to flag an ambiguity: there are **two approved invoices**, and no payments have been sent yet:

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-36368 | $4,549.02 | approved | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-53266 | $4,268.44 | approved | 2026-11-04 |

(There's also a draft invoice INV-52633 awaiting approval, and an older one already paid.)

The vendor's bank details are verified and both wire and ACH rails are available, so I can pay immediately once you confirm. Since this involves real funds and you asked for "the approved invoice" (singular), I don't want to guess:

- Should I pay **only INV-53266** (the sooner-due one), **only INV-36368**, or **both**?
- Do you have a preferred rail? Wire is available, so I'll default to wire.

Also note each amount is under $10,000, so no controller approval is required. Just confirm which invoice(s) to pay and I'll execute the wire exactly once and report back with the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-36368, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.
